title: Tensor-factor signed-shift squares
statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorSignedShifts_tensorSquares
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g D) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T)
    (SY : PodTensorSignedShift l E Y) (SX : PodTensorSignedShift l E X) :
    (∀ (M N M' N' : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) (r : ℤ)
      (a : M'.obj ≅ M.obj⟦r⟧) (b : N'.obj ≅ N.obj⟦r⟧), equation₁) ∧
    (∀ (M N M' N' : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) (r : ℤ)
      (a : M'.obj ≅ M.obj⟦r⟧) (b : N'.obj ≅ N.obj⟦r⟧), equation₂)

proof.text: On homogeneous tensor generators reindexing preserves degrees and signs. Generator extensionality and the normalized Roos equations descend the two factor squares to completed tensor objects and derived presentations.
